decisions.reason: The platter got only a passing mention on the website, so the firm made little visible commitment to it, but management will likely give a 2023 organic launch more time and blame weak early results on a temporarily soft organic market.
A dedicated web page signals public commitment and investment in the organic poultry snack direction, so management will persist and attribute any slow uptake to temporary market conditions.
The premium sharing snack was presented prominently on its own page and fits the firm's announced premium snacking direction, so sunk investment and the need to justify the launch favor keeping it.
